item.title: Gunman Demands Cash During Robbery at Schuylkill County Lottery and Tobacco Store
item.description: Pennsylvania State Police are investigating an armed robbery that occurred Monday night at Sam’s Place Lottery and Tobacco in Rush Township. According to state police at the Frackville barracks, the incident occurred on December 15, 2025, at approximately 8:55 p.m. at the business located at 45 Plaza Drive in Schuylkill County. item.title: Penn State Schuylkill Alumnus Establishes Scholarship Honoring Parents
item.description: Penn State Schuylkill alumnus Louis H. “Herb” Meier has established a new endowed scholarship at Penn State Schuylkill to support first-generation college students from Schuylkill County with demonstrated financial need. The Elbert and Helen Meier Scholarship is open to full-time undergraduate students who are enrolled at, or planning to enroll at, Penn State Schuylkill. item.title: Schuylkill County Native Promoted to National Role at Mrs. T’s Pierogies
item.description: Ateeco, Inc., producer of Mrs. T’s® Pierogies, has announced the promotion of Dominic Tedesco to National Account Manager, Retail Sales. Tedesco began his career with Mrs. T’s in 2020 as a Business Analyst on the Revenue Growth Management Team, where he focused on data analytics and sales support. His work in that role led to a promotion to Senior Business Analyst in 2023. item.title: Minersville Area School District Closed Thursday for Third Consecutive Day Following Cybersecurity Incident
item.description: The Minersville Area School District will remain closed on Thursday, December 18, 2025, marking the third consecutive day of canceled classes as the district continues to respond to a cybersecurity incident involving its computer network. District officials initially took the network offline earlier this week after security tools detected attempts to install malware on certain systems.
